retrieval: Read through GitHub connector; pinned content matched inspected main-branch content. Public README also inspected. No upstream code was run.
adaptation: Original academic instructions informed by whole-passage rhetorical diagnosis, author samples and post-revision rereading. No upstream examples or instruction text bundled. Existing academic evidence and scope safeguards remain controlling.
academic_boundaries: Automatic diagnosis from any single phrase or an authorship cutoff date
Blanket word bans or generic replacement of represent/associate with identity/causation
Adding personal reactions or matching punctuation frequency without explicit authorization
Mandatory alternating sentence lengths or draft-critique-final delivery
Removing study provenance, uncertainty or self-contained premises as conversational repetition
interpretation_note: These boundaries specify our academic use; they do not claim that the upstream project requires every excluded behavior. Humanizer also instructs writers to preserve meaning and contains contextual exceptions.
